newsitem.title: USA: Continental Materials cites sales mix.
newsitem.headline: Continental Materials cites sales mix.

text.p: Continental Materials Corp said Thursday that despite a sales increase, operating income for both the quarter and the six month periods declined due, in part, to an unfavorable sales mix at its heating and air conditioning business.
Results were also impacted by an increase in non-cash expenses in the construction materials segment as a result of the acquisition of a ready-mix concrete operation.

Earlier today, the company reported 1997 second quarter earnings fell to about $1.0 million or $0.92 a share from $1.4 million or $1.24 in the same period a year ago. Sales rose to about $28.0 million from $27.1 million in the 1996 quarter.

The combined sales volume of the company's three construction materials subsidiaries improved due to the acquisition of the Pueblo ready-mix concrete and aggregates operation during the last quarter of 1996. Construction activity in the Colorado Springs area declined as expected to a more modest, but still healthy, level, it said.

Sales in the company's heating and air conditioning business declined as relatively cool weather, particularly in May and June 1997, affected sales of evaporative coolers at its Phoenix Manufacturing Inc operation.
